title: Video Editor Intern - Walkin
description:
**About Us**

Creative Point is a digital marketing agency in Coimbatore. We handle SEO, Social Media Marketing, Web Development, Web Design, Bulk SMS, and Meta \& Google Ads for a wide range of clients. We're on the lookout for a creative Video Editor Intern to join our team and help bring ideas to life on screen.

**About the Role**

We're looking for someone who enjoys both shooting and editing videos \- you'll work on content for our own brand as well as for our clients across different industries. It's a great chance to get hands\-on experience, learn fast, and build a solid portfolio while working on real projects, not just practice assignments.

**What You'll Do**

* Shoot videos for in\-house and client work \- reels, ads, product shoots, behind\-the\-scenes, etc.
* Edit raw footage into clean, engaging videos for social media, ads, and websites
* Add music, effects, text, and transitions to match the brand's vibe
* Work closely with our design and marketing folks to keep videos on\-brief and on\-brand
* Tweak videos for different platforms — Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and more
* Keep footage and project files organized
* Keep an eye on trending reel styles and editing techniques

**What We're Looking For**

* Comfortable with editing tools like Premiere Pro, CapCut, Final Cut Pro, or similar
* Basic know\-how of shooting with a camera or phone (framing, lighting, angles)
* A good sense of storytelling and pacing
* Curious, open to feedback, and quick to pick up new styles
* Able to work on\-site in Coimbatore
* A sample reel or portfolio (college projects or personal work)

**What You'll Get**

* Real hands\-on experience with live client projects
* Exposure to different industries and content styles
* Internship completion certificate
* Guidance from an experienced team
* A portfolio that actually shows what you can do

**Walk\-in Interview Details**

**Date:** 24th September 2026 – 30th September 2026  
**Venue:** Creative Point, Coimbatore  
**Time:** 10 AM – 4 PM

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 \- ₹6,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Internet reimbursement

Work Location: In person

title: Lead Fashion Design
description:
Job Title: Lead \- Fashion Design

Location: Coimbatore

Employment Type: Full\-time (In person)

About the Role

We are a made\-to\-order bespoke clothing brand seeking a talented professional who can combine fashion design expertise with strong sales and client management skills. If you are passionate about fashion design, fabrics, silhouettes, and styling—and also enjoy interacting with customers and driving sales—this role is perfect for you.

Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement \& Sales

* Greet clients warmly and provide a premium, personalized experience.
* Understand customer needs thoroughly and recommend suitable fashion design options.
* Confidently present design ideas, fabric choices, and customization options.
* Convert walk\-ins and online leads into confirmed orders using strong sales skills.
* Follow up with potential clients regularly to drive conversions and meet monthly sales targets.
* Be sales\-oriented and proactive in achieving and exceeding sales goals.

Fashion Design Consultation \& Product Knowledge

* Offer expert fashion design consultations based on trends, body types, and client preferences.
* Stay updated on latest fashion design trends, silhouettes, cuts, and bespoke detailing.
* Suggest appropriate fabrics and design elements to enhance client satisfaction.
* Work closely with the production coordinator to ensure accurate design specifications and timely delivery.
* Contribute ideas for new collections, sampling, and overall fashion design improvements.

Store Growth \& Walk\-in Strategies

* Develop creative strategies to increase store walk\-ins and brand visibility.
* Collaborate with marketing to create campaigns that highlight new designs and fabric launches.
* Provide proactive ideas for events, display changes, and seasonal design promotions.

Presentation \& Professionalism

* Maintain excellent grooming standards that reflect the brand’s premium image.
* Ensure the store environment aligns with a luxury, made\-to\-order fashion design studio.
* Demonstrate proactive, solution\-oriented behaviour in everyday operations.

Requirements and Skills:

* Qualifications: Bachelors in Fashion Design / Fashion Technology or Equivalent
* Strong interest and knowledge in fashion design, styling, and fabrics.
* Experience in bespoke wear, fashion retail, or sales is a plus.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple clients and coordinate with production teams.
* Self\-driven, sales\-oriented, and passionate about achieving high performance.

Salary and Perks:

* Salary starts: from Rs. 25000 per month upto Rs. 30000 per month
* Salary Includes free Accommodation

Why Join Us?

* Work in a creative, design\-driven environment.
* Opportunity to apply and grow your fashion design and client styling skills.
* Growth potential with performance\-based incentives.
